# Softpedia — Mac review and conflicting requirements

- Original title: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood For Mac
- Source: [Original publication](https://mac.softpedia.com/get/Games/Robin-Hood.shtml)
- Author / publisher: George Popescu; Softpedia
- Language / date: English; listing updated 2015-03-15; review date not separately shown
- Access: Review, version metadata, and requirements inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

Popescu rates the game four out of five and praises its accessible installation, changing tactical situations, and nonlinear progression. The listing identifies version 1.1.0 with unspecified improvements and fixes for user-reported bugs.

Its requirements conflict internally: the header specifies Intel-only OS X 10.9 or later and an 871 MB download, while a lower section repeats G3/G4 hardware requirements. This suggests mixed historical metadata, not evidence that the same build supports both architectures. Compare the [2012 MacUpdate listing](macupdate-intel-version.md) when identifying editions; neither catalogue was tested against an installer.
